questions.question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

The government will spend a hundred crore in upgrading infrastructure of the hospitals.

options.text: A hundred crore will be spent in upgrading infrastructure of the hospitals
Upgrading infrastructure of the hospitals will be spent in a hundred crore
A hundred crore will have been spent in upgrading infrastructure of the hospitals.
A hundred crore will be spending in upgrading infrastructure of the hospitals.

questions.solution:

• The given sentence is in active form which means *the thing doing the action is the subject of the sentence and the thing receiving the action is the object. *
 
• Structure of the sentence in active form:-
 
 
• Subject + Main Verb/ Helping Verb + Object.
 
• For example:-* The ball hit him.*
 
 
 
• ​Passive form of a sentence is a sentence i.e. *being used when the grammatical subject is the person or thing that experiences the effect of an action, rather than the person or thing that causes the effect.*
 
• In order to convert the given sentence in** passive form**, we have to follow the structure given below:-
 
• Structure of the sentence:- Subject + Helping Verb + V3 + by + the + Object.
 
 
• For example:- *He was hit by the ball.*
 
 
 
• The **subject**(*The government*) and the **object**(*a hundred crore*) of the given sentence present in an** active form** will **interchange **their place while converting it into a **passive form**.
 
• '**Will spend**' used in an active form will be **converted **into '**will be spent**' in the **passive form**.
 
• After **conversion, **the **correct form** of the sentence would be:-
 
• A hundred crore will be spent in upgrading the infrastructure of the hospitals.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

• Thermal energy is the internal energy present in a system of thermodynamic equilibrium by virtue of its temperature.

• It is produced when the temperature of the system rises to the rapid collision of atoms and molecules in a system.
 
• A change in thermal energy can also change the state of a particular substance and does obey the law of conservation of energy.

• Water bodies, mountains, and vegetation also influence wind flow patterns.
 
• The sites with suitable energy in the wind are chosen and wind turbines are placed and the area is called wind farms.

questions.question: Genes in a human being are located in:
questions.solution:
**Genes are responsible for heredity. They are present on chromosomes at fixed points.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Genes are present on chromosomes.**
 
• The Genes are the ‘Mendelian factors,’ present in pairs (one received from the father, the other from the mother), on the chromosomes.
 
• One member of a **pair of genes present on the chromosomes** has its pair on the homologous chromosome at the same location.
 
• **Genes** are the bearers of hereditary characters or the units of heredity.
 
• **A chromosome contains one molecule of the chemical called DNA.**
 
• **Genes present on chromosomes are segments of DNA.** 
 
• Each chromosome is made of one molecule of the chemical called DNA or deoxyribonucleic acid and some proteins. 
 
• Since every individual begins life as a single cell, the DNA contained in all the cells of an individual is identical.

**Thus, it is concluded that the Genes in a human being are located in chromosomes.**
